## Reading the text

```{python}
import pandas as pd

with open("hw5_raw.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

print(len(lines))
print(lines[:10])
```

I imported pandas, then pasted the transcript into a text file then put the lines from it into a list. Next I printed the number of the lines and the first 10 lines to check that it opened correctly.


## Cleaning the text and building the table

```{python}
rows = []
speaker = ""
line_number = 0

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()

    if line != "":
        if ": " in line:
            parts = line.split(": ")
            speaker = parts[0]
            line = ": ".join(parts[1:])

        if speaker != "MUSIC":
            line_number += 1
            rows.append({
                "line": line,
                "speaker": speaker,
                "line_number": line_number
            })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

print(len(df))
df.head(10)
```

I went through the text with a loop and removed extra spaces and newline characters. Then seperated the speakers' names from the dialogue and kept the same speaker until another name was there. I left out the blank lines and the section labeled MUSIC because I wanted to focus on dialogue. After I made a table with the line, speaker, and line number.


## Adding new columns

```{python}
df["length"] = df["line"].str.len()
df["lower"] = df["line"].str.lower()
df["is_question"] = df["line"].str.endswith("?")

df.head(10)
```

I added 3 columns to show the character count, a lowercase version of each line, and whether the line ends with a quesiton mark. If its true it means it ends with a question mark. If it doesn't end with a question mark it's false.


## Saving and checking the CSV

```{python}
df.to_csv("hw5_loftis_emily.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")

saved_df = pd.read_csv("hw5_loftis_emily.csv")

print(len(saved_df))
saved_df.head(10)
```


I saved my table as a CSV without the extra index column. Then I opened the CSV again and printed the number of rows and the first 10 rows to check that it saved correctly.
